g.text: MCP 2026-07-28 mid-interaction authorization with RAR remediation
one-shot token bound to ONE operation; "authorization required" carried as 401, JSON-RPC error -32010 or MRTR input_required (negotiated per request)
0. Bootstrap: SESSION token (scope=mcp:basic) and binding negotiation
No session: every request carries _meta clientCapabilities =
}}} (what the client HANDLES, in preference order).
Per request, the server answers "authorization required" with the client's first preference it offers;

(401). stdio: T1 comes from the environment (MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN),
the era is negotiated with server/discover, and since stdio has no 401, "http" becomes "inband".
1. Transfer: the tool discovers it needs a per-operation grant
2. Pre-authorization confirmation: MRTR round (UX only, never the authorization)
3. "Authorization required" for op_X (atomic: nothing committed) -- carried in the NEGOTIATED form
: client declared nothing (or nothing in common); the interoperable default]
stepUpFetch HOLDS request id=3 (below the SDK)
: client declared bindings:["inband", …] (and always on stdio instead of http)]
the request IS answered (with an error);
the request IS answered, successfully: NOT an error.
call-tool.ts sees the _meta hint (manual MRTR mode)
4. Client remediation: ONE-SHOT token for op_X (identical for every binding)
op_X stays awaiting_authorization until TTL -> failed.
5. Retry with T2 (form depends on the binding), then claim atomically and commit once
6. Later calls keep using the SESSION token
token presented on ANOTHER operation, or other parameters
8. Guard: challenge after a side effect (non-atomic tool)
With known payees nothing is committed first: one challenge carries N details
(instruction_id op_B-1 … op_B-N), so one consent and one token cover the batch.
• Tools never advertise the requirement; it is discovered during execution.
• One outcome, three carriers, negotiated per request (lab extension lab.stepup/rar-remediation):
http 401 insufficient_authorization: the JSON-RPC request is unanswered, the client replays the SAME request (default)
inband JSON-RPC error -32010: the request is answered, the client retries as a NEW call naming op_X in _meta
mrtr resultType "input_required" + requestState + _meta hint: NOT an error, the client retries echoing requestState
Server policy: CHALLENGE_BINDING (negotiate | mrtr | http | inband). Client list: AGENT_BINDINGS.
• authorization_details carry instruction_id = the server's operation id: a grant authorizes ONE operation instance.
• Claim = executing + jti spent, atomically, before any side effect; completed operations return their stored result.
• Operation token: authorization_details only, NO scope, short TTL, no refresh. Session token (mcp:basic) is never replaced.
• A refusal is a tool result (isError), not a transport error. Elicitation is UX, never the authorization itself.
• Open gap: the AS cannot verify the RS issued the instruction_id (a server-signed remediation would close it).
